title: Add specs Tool kind to types and config schemas
description: Add `specs` to `TOOL_KINDS`, `ToolKindSchema`, and the `Tool` / `CreateToolInput` / `UpdateToolInput` unions in `src/agents/tools/tools.types.ts`. Create `SpecsToolConfigSchema` with a non-empty `permissions` array (`spec:list`, `spec:read`, `spec:update`, `task:list`, `task:read`, `task:update`). Add `specs` to `parseUpdateToolInput`. Add `SPECS_API_SIGNING_KEY` to `ServerEnvSchema` in `src/env.server.ts`.
acceptance_criteria: Existing tool type tests still pass

title: Implement per-Turn specs JWT token module
description: Create `src/agents/runs/specs-token.ts` with `mintSpecsToken(claims, signingKey)` and `verifySpecsToken(token, signingKey)` using HS256 via `crypto.subtle`. Claims include `project_id`, `run_id`, `turn_id`, `permissions`, `exp`. Write unit tests for sign/verify, expiry rejection, invalid signature, and malformed token.
acceptance_criteria: `mintSpecsToken` returns a compact JWT string signed with HS256
`verifySpecsToken` validates signature and expiry and returns claims

title: Implement specs internal API controller
description: Create `src/agents/tools/specs-api.controller.ts` with six routes under `/api/internal/specs`: GET /specs (list), GET /specs/:specId (read with tasks), PATCH /specs/:specId (update), GET /specs/:specId/tasks (list tasks), GET /tasks/:taskId (read task), PATCH /tasks/:taskId (update task). Each handler validates the Bearer [REDACTED] via `verifySpecsToken`, checks the required permission, and calls `SpecsService` / `TasksService` with `claims.project_id`. Convert descriptions between Markdown and TipTap content using `MarkdownManager`. Register routes in `app/root.tsx` under the existing `/api/internal` group. Write integration tests for each endpoint covering happy path, 401 (no/invalid token), 403 (missing permission), and 404 (nonexistent spec/task).
acceptance_criteria: All six endpoints return correct data for valid tokens with matching permissions
Update endpoints accept Markdown descriptions and persist as TipTap content

title: Integrate specs token into Turn runtime and runner args
description: Add `specsApiSecrets(token, callbackUrl)` to `src/infra/sandboxes/sandbox-secrets.ts` returning a host-scoped secret `HUUMA_SPECS_API_TOKEN` scoped to the Studio host derived from `RUN_TURN_CALLBACK_URL`. Update `AgentRuntimeService.resolve()` to extract the `specs` tool config and return `specsPermissions` in `ResolvedAgentRuntime` and `PreparedAgentRuntime`. Update `TurnRuntimeService.start()` to mint the specs JWT in the `resolveSecrets` callback when `specsPermissions` is present, and add the secret alongside model and GitHub secrets. Update `ManagedTurnLaunchInput` and `managedTurnArgs` in `src/infra/sandboxes/runner.ts` with `--specs-permissions` and `--specs-api-url` args. Derive `specsApiUrl` from `RunTurnConfig.callbackUrl` origin. Write tests for the Turn launch path with a `specs` tool linked.
acceptance_criteria: `AgentRuntimeService.resolve()` returns `specsPermissions` when the agent has a linked `specs` tool
`TurnRuntimeService.start()` mints a JWT and includes it in sandbox secrets when `specsPermissions` is present
`managedTurnArgs` emits `--specs-permissions` and `--specs-api-url` when `specs` is in tools
`specsApiUrl` is derived from the callback URL origin
No JWT is minted when the agent has no `specs` tool

title: Update frontend tool form and display for specs kind
description: Add `specs: "Specs"` to `TOOL_KIND_LABELS` in `tool-kind-labels.ts`. Add `specsPermissions` to `ToolFormValues` in `tool-form-values.ts` and update `buildCreateToolInput` / `buildUpdateToolInput` to build the `specs` config. Add a permissions checkbox group section to `tool-form.client.tsx` for the `specs` kind (Specs: List/Read/Update, Tasks: List/Read/Update) with at-least-one-permission validation. Update `tool-detail.ts` to display `specs` config (permissions list) in read-only view. Update `tool-card.ts` for the `specs` kind. Write UI tests for form validation.
acceptance_criteria: `specs` appears in the tool kind dropdown with label "Specs"
Selecting `specs` shows a permissions checkbox group
At least one permission must be selected to submit
Create and update flows persist the permissions config correctly
Tool detail page displays the permissions list

title: Implement specs tool kind in @huuma/cli runner
description: Update the `@huuma/cli` runner (separate repo) to recognize `specs` in `--tools`, parse `--specs-permissions` and `--specs-api-url`, and implement the six tool functions (list_specs, read_spec, update_spec, list_tasks, read_task, update_task). Each function makes an HTTP request to the Studio API with the `HUUMA_SPECS_API_TOKEN` placeholder in the Authorization header. Only expose functions for which the corresponding permission is present. Pin the new `@huuma/cli` version in `src/infra/sandboxes/runner.config.ts`. Run an end-to-end test: agent lists specs, reads a spec, updates a task status.
acceptance_criteria: Six tool functions make authenticated HTTP calls to the Studio API
Only permitted functions are exposed to the model
End-to-end test passes: list specs, read spec, update task
